Start from the catalog's Target candidates; catalog rules are unchanged. Off target: the highest tissue value outside tumors and reproductive tissue, Disposable tissue included, is below 4 TPM. Curation: no cited normal function or expression in a Vital or Protected tissue. Curation: not a read-through of other protein-coding genes.
